cases.comparison: Keep exact header/endpoint parsing and partial journal; permit the exact native -u header without a state column only with matching live connected UDP socket and procfs local/peer/inode/UID witnesses before and after.
cases.oracle: Independently witnessed socket ownership, live procfs identities and native ss controls; literal selectors and listening state.
cases.purpose: Literal repeated selectors with the exact native no-State UDP layout and independently verified connected UDP socket/proc tuple.
cases.script:
export PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
H=/tmp/parity-home
holder=
finish() {
 local incoming=$? term=0 waited=0 forced=0 judge_rc=0
 trap - EXIT
 if [[ -n $holder ]]; then
  kill -TERM "$holder" 2>/dev/null; term=$?
  for ((j=0;j<40;j++)); do kill -0 "$holder" 2>/dev/null || break; /usr/bin/sleep 0.05; done
  if kill -0 "$holder" 2>/dev/null; then forced=1; kill -KILL "$holder" 2>/dev/null; fi
  wait "$holder" 2>/dev/null; waited=$?
  holder=
 fi
 printf '{"incoming_status":%s,"term_status":%s,"wait_status":%s,"forced":%s}\n' "$incoming" "$term" "$waited" "$forced" > "$H/ss-cleanup.json" || incoming=125
 /usr/bin/python3 -B "$PWD/judge.py" > "$H/ss-analysis.stdout" 2> "$H/ss-analysis.stderr"; judge_rc=$?
 if [[ $incoming == 0 && $term == 0 && $waited == 0 && $forced == 0 && $judge_rc == 0 ]]; then
  /usr/bin/cat "$H/ss-analysis.stdout" || exit 125
  exit 0
 fi
 printf 'CONTROL-INCOMPLETE: scenario or cleanup failed; partial journal retained\n' >&2
 exit 125
}
trap finish EXIT
/usr/bin/python3 -B "$PWD/socket-holder.py" >"$H/ss-holder.out" 2>"$H/ss-holder.err" & holder=$!
for ((i=0;i<100;i++)); do [[ -s "$H/ss-holder-before.json" ]] && break; kill -0 "$holder" 2>/dev/null || break; /usr/bin/sleep 0.05; done
[[ -s "$H/ss-holder-before.json" ]] || { printf 'CONTROL-INCOMPLETE holder startup\n' >&2; exit 125; }
/usr/bin/python3 -B "$PWD/ready-check.py" "$holder" "$BASHPID" 2>>"$H/ss-holder.err" || { printf 'CONTROL-INCOMPLETE holder identity\n' >&2; exit 125; }
run_one() {
 local side=$1 label=$2 rc; shift 2
 if [[ $side == candidate ]]; then builtin ss "$@" >"$H/ss-$side-$label.out" 2>"$H/ss-$side-$label.err"; rc=$?
 else /usr/bin/ss "$@" >"$H/ss-$side-$label.out" 2>"$H/ss-$side-$label.err"; rc=$?; fi
 /usr/bin/python3 -B "$PWD/record.py" "$side" "$label" "$rc" "$BASHPID" "$@" || exit 125
}
[[ $(type -t ss) == builtin ]] || { printf 'CONTROL-INCOMPLETE ss not builtin\n' >&2; exit 125; }
for side in native candidate; do
 run_one "$side" tcp -t
 run_one "$side" udp -u
 run_one "$side" unix -x
 run_one "$side" listen -l
done
cases.setup_script:
[[ $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
IFS= read -r token </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $token =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
